scope: One graph launch with eight device-controlled producer/routed-Delaunay/consumer phases; includes full 4096-site reuse, smaller prefix, unrelated inputs, invalid count, nonfinite input and recovery. Setup, upload, final readback and independent checks are outside profiling.
copy_trace_limit: Nsight may omit graph copy activity records; both observed copy kinds and all DOT copy nodes are checked for device-to-device direction.
